jeannette-c-alvarado.text: Calls for reassessing the district's efforts "to provide more professional resources such as therapists, counselors and psychologists for students," and for helping parents support students in and out of class.

source.title: Ballotpedia: Jeannette C. Alvarado Candidate Connection survey (2026)

jeannette-c-alvarado.text: Wants teachers to get training and tools "to teach our students how to use technology responsibly," including how to tell true from false information online.

source.title: Ballotpedia: Jeannette C. Alvarado Candidate Connection survey (2026)

jeannette-c-alvarado.text: Wants to use school data to make sure schools, especially in her trustee area, get resources and interventions for students who are struggling most: "It's time to close the achievement gap."

source.title: Ballotpedia: Jeannette C. Alvarado Candidate Connection survey (2026)

jeannette-c-alvarado.text: On a proposed data center near her community: "More needs to be done by our government officials to regulate it and hold these companies accountable," citing harm to health and the environment.

source.title: Ballotpedia: Jeannette C. Alvarado Candidate Connection survey (2026)

brandon-m-macias.text: Platform calls for training all staff on immigration encounters, telling parents no school information will go to law enforcement "without a warrant," know-your-rights workshops with free legal aid, and a strict ban on staff collecting students' immigration status.

source.title: Brandon Macias for RUSD campaign site: Platform (2026)

brandon-m-macias.text: Platform: "Study after study has shown that standardized tests are abysmal for actually measuring learning"; he would work with educators on other measures of student learning.

source.title: Brandon Macias for RUSD campaign site: Platform (2026)

brandon-m-macias.text: Platform: "Strong schools mean strong unions." Would seek pay and benefit parity across union contracts, better retirement benefits, smaller contractual class sizes, and more hiring of aides.

source.title: Brandon Macias for RUSD campaign site: Platform (2026)

brandon-m-macias.text: Proposes funding two more in-house bus routes, aligned with the East Valinda shuttle, for morning pickup and afternoon drop-off.

source.title: Brandon Macias for RUSD campaign site: Platform (2026)

brandon-m-macias.text: Proposes moving student-assistant tutors from online homework help into elementary classrooms, and adding welding, HVAC and construction CTE pathways through Mt. SAC.

source.title: Brandon Macias for RUSD campaign site: Platform (2026)

brandon-m-macias.text: His campaign site points voters to his "recent work against Data Centers in SGV."
